about: Recorded coordinator wake digests of one busy project, the latest 120 in order: per wake its sections in order, each [label hash, chars, content hash]; the first is ["head", time header chars, rest chars, rest hash], the last the new events. Sizes and hashes only, no text. The Open tasks section (label fcb7ec) also carries its rows after the header line: [task key hash ('#'...) or '~' for another line, chars, hash without ages, hash as shown].
